intros f s
have hf : (↑f).Finite := by apply_instance
have hs : (↑s).Finite := by apply_instance
let fs := ↑f
let ss := ↑s
let img := λ g, g '' ss
have himg : ∀ g ∈ fs, (img g).Finite := 
  by { intro g, intro hg, exact Finite.Set.finite_image ss g hf }
apply Set.Finite.union_of_finite_images hf himg
